name: Form Validation
description: Dependency-free accessible form validation with inline errors on blur and submit, aria-invalid, live-region messages, and first-invalid focus.
usage: Add novalidate + data-validate to the form, give each .field__control an id and aria-describedby pointing at a .field__error region, declare native constraints (required, type, minlength, pattern) plus optional data-match and data-error-* messages. script.js auto-wires blur/submit validation, aria-invalid and focus management.
